items.claim: Node moved into a wide container with its box unchanged is never put into the child BVH
Visibility-index cache grows by one entry per `paintBounds`/`toPose` identity, with no bound
items.note: (it now keeps the four most recently used pairs per scene)

items.claim: A paste onto a page keeps the copied layer instead of the page's
`geometryGenerationOf` can return a value it returned before
items.note: (it is now a counter that only goes up, bumped whenever the painter set or any painter's generation changes; added `nodeOutline.ts` to `scripts/check-part-caches.allow.mjs` with the reason)

items.claim: `reportCommandLosses` ignores group effect programs that have no GLSL source
`affineImage` drops the `BOX_ALL` answer for a non-finite copy image, so it gets unioned as the box at the origin
items.note: (public `BoxImage` may now return `BoxKind`, so that changeset is `minor`)

items.claim: pixelPickEvery returns unsorted hits when a later pass can't read
createCanvasReader opens a WebGL2 context before the canvas has a backend
items.note: It now answers null until the canvas's first renderer is built. Three hud loupe test files used bare canvases with no renderer, so they now record a backend through a new `rememberBackend` export in `@weasel-js/core/testing/canvas`.

items.claim: useStandInLayers reads the ref during render, so a canvas mounting under a stand-in already shown never applies it
items.note: It reads again after commit, and only re-renders when that read could come out differently, so a SceneCanvas mount costs no extra render in the common case.

items.claim: Layer sampler renders with no view matrix, so `units: 'world'` gradients are sampled in screen space
items.note: The plan now carries `view` (world → raster pixels), and `RasterSession.renderCommands` takes a `view` option. That is new API, so it has its own `minor` changeset.

items.claim: renderDebugSnapshot at `pixelRatio` > 1 draws `{ px }` lengths at a fraction of their size
items.note: `renderSceneToPixels` and `planPixelRender` take a new `pixelRatio`, with its own `minor` changeset. I made the strict call and recorded it in `docs/unruled.md`: `'screen'` units are measured in CSS px at that ratio, and a ratio that is not a positive finite number throws.

items.claim: An adopted pick id still on the free list gets handed to a second node
A copy that includes a page drops the hidden sources of a derived node on that page
A drop-point paste measures its cluster origin from edges' placeholder poses
